say:1:1641110001:1.text: If you're looking to make friends, there's no better place than the school training grounds.
say:1:1641110001:1.source_cn: 啊，有一个好地方最适合认识新朋友了，学院的魔法练习场。

say:2:1641110002:1.text: Come Tuesday afternoons, you'll find little clusters of students gathered there—snacking, chatting, and fiercely arguing about the finer points of magic theory.
say:2:1641110002:1.source_cn: 每逢周二下午，总有三五成群的学生散坐那儿，一边分享着点...

say:12:1641110010:1.text: The group next to mine didn't even flinch—they just laughed and helped clean up.
say:12:1641110010:1.source_cn: 隔壁组的同学不但没躲开，反而笑着帮我收拾残局。

say:13:1641110011:1.text: They've been my best spell partners ever since.

say:14:1641110012:1.text: At the Lyceum, nothing breaks the ice like shared magical disaster.
say:14:1641110012:1.source_cn: 总之，在莱希拉姆，再没有比魔法交流更加容易的破冰方式了。
